AI response:
AGREEMENT_STATUS: disagree
MUST_FIX:
1. **Physical & Dataset Joins ([`associate_images`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/transfer_dataset.py#L60-L77))**: In [`tool/transfer_dataset.py`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/transfer_dataset.py), `associate_images` raises `ValueError` if any split row view is missing from `published` or if its dish is absent from `metadata`. Because Kaggle NV-Real v2 split CSV contains ~1,500 split views while the public file listing only contains 892 files, this immediately crashes on real data. Skip unpublished views or unlisted dishes (`continue`) instead of aborting the entire join, and handle uppercase extensions (`.JPG`, `.JPEG`) case-insensitively.
2. **Counterfactual Arm Masking ([`score_transfer`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/transfer_dataset.py#L110-L163))**: In [`tool/transfer_dataset.py`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/transfer_dataset.py), when the specialist fails (`s.get('status') != 'ok'`), `fused` defaults to `base` (A1) and scores `base`. A counterfactual mass arm must isolate specialist mass substitution; falling back to A1 scores 20 valid cases even under total specialist failure, disguising failures as successes. Reserve fallback exclusively for `OldServingGate` and record `point = None` for failed counterfactual runs.
3. **Unsafe Key Access on Failed Fallback**: In [`score_transfer`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/transfer_dataset.py#L149-L152), `old['selectedSource']` throws `KeyError` when both generalist and specialist fail. Replace with `old.get('selectedSource')`.
4. **Sparse A0 Denominator**: In [`run_transfer_a1.cjs`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/run_transfer_a1.cjs#L66-L68), requiring `typeof c.catalogId === 'string'` causes 100% of transfer cases to fail with `catalog_coverage_failure` because open-food VLM predictions do not emit closed catalog IDs. Downstream evaluators and screens must explicitly guard against zero-coverage / sparse denominators when computing A0-normalized errors.
5. **Private Hash & Manifest Ambiguity**: In [`prepare_transfer_eval.py`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/prepare_transfer_eval.py#L60-L75), `selection.json` is frozen pre-fetch without `inputPath`/`inputSha256`, while `manifest.json` records them post-fetch. Both runners verify `profile.manifestSha256` against `manifest.json`, leaving `selection.json` unused. Standardize on pinning `manifest.json` and pass `sort_keys=True` to `_write` to avoid cross-environment key-ordering hash drift.
6. **Worker Error Trace Privacy Leak**: In [`tool/run_transfer_lens.py`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/run_transfer_lens.py#L53-L57), `worker` re-raises exceptions after writing failure status. The unhandled exception writes a raw traceback to `stderr`, which [`supervise`](file:///home/agent-runner/.local/share/calorix-cross-dataset-20261111/review/tool/run_transfer_lens.py#L96-L98) captures into `supervision.json`, risking private path/data leakage. Map errors to safe string categories and exit cleanly.
